The three notebooks share `fun/convergence_parameters.R`. The exact
reference, physical data, quadrature and error norm are identical. Outputs
use the original fixed filenames under `data_files/` and `data_files/tikzpic/`.

```{r}
source(here::here("sourceifupdated.R"))
source_if_updated("fun/fractional_evolution")
source_if_updated("fun/exact_solutions")
source_if_updated("fun/tadpole_convergence")
source_if_updated("fun/plotting")
source_if_updated("fun/metafunctions")
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = FALSE, cache = FALSE, echo = TRUE)
fig_count <- 0
captioner <- function(caption) {
  fig_count <<- fig_count + 1
  paste0("Figure ", fig_count, ": ", caption)
}
```

```{r}
# Parameters: edit the one shared file, then rerun all three notebooks.
source(here::here("fun/convergence_parameters.R"), local = TRUE)
study_parameters <- list(problem = convergence_parameters, alpha = alpha_vector,
                         h = h_fixed, tau = time_step_fixed, m = m_vector)
```

We vary m=1,2,3,4, keeping h=1e-5 and tau=1e-10 fixed. This range is
independent of m=8 used in the h/tau studies. The theorem's root-exponential
factor supplies an upper-bound benchmark; finite-order slopes need not equal
it, and the curves need not be straight. The legend reports that benchmark
and the observed slope without a percentage "agreement error".

```{r}
# Compute the error matrix and save at the original main-branch location.
errors_projected <- matrix(NA_real_, length(m_vector), length(alpha_vector))
for (i in seq_along(m_vector)) {
  for (j in seq_along(alpha_vector)) {
    errors_projected[i, j] <- tadpole_convergence_error(
      h = h_fixed, time_step = time_step_fixed, m = m_vector[i],
      alpha = alpha_vector[j], parameters = convergence_parameters
    )
  }
}
save(errors_projected, study_parameters,
     file = here::here("data_files/errors_projected_m.RData"))
```

```{r}
# Verify that the fixed-name results belong to the parameters above.
saved <- new.env()
load(here::here("data_files/errors_projected_m.RData"), envir = saved)
stopifnot(identical(saved$study_parameters, study_parameters))
errors_projected <- saved$errors_projected
```

```{r}
observed_rates <- numeric(length(alpha_vector))
for (u in 1:length(alpha_vector)) {
  observed_rates[u] <- coef(lm(log(errors_projected[, u]) ~ sqrt(m_vector)))[2]
}

theoretical_rates <- -2 * pi * sqrt(1 - alpha_vector / 2)

p_m_tadpole <- error.convergence.plotter(x_axis_vector = m_vector, 
                                 alpha_vector, 
                                 errors_projected, 
                                 theoretical_rates, 
                                 observed_rates,
                                 line_equation_fun = exp_line_equation,
                                 fig_title = expression("Convergence in " * italic(m)),
                                 x_axis_label = expression(italic(m)),
                                 apply_sqrt = TRUE)

p_m_nicer_tadpole <- errorConvergencePlotterLatex(x_axis_vector = m_vector, 
                                 alpha_vector, 
                                 errors_projected, 
                                 theoretical_rates, 
                                 observed_rates,
                                 line_equation_fun = exp_line_equation,
                                 fig_title = "$\\mbox{Convergence in }m$",
                                 x_axis_label = "$m\\quad(\\sqrt{\\phantom{x}}\\mbox{ scale})$",
                                 y_axis_label = "$\\|u-U_{h,m}^{\\tau}\\|_{L_2(\\Gamma\\times[0,T])}\\quad(\\log_{\\mathrm{e}}\\mbox{ scale})$",
                                 color_label = "$\\alpha\\;|\\;\\mathtt{bound}\\;|\\;\\mathtt{obs}$",
                                 apply_sqrt = TRUE)

ggsave(here::here("data_files/conv_rates_m_tadpole.png"), width = 4, height = 5, plot = p_m_tadpole, dpi = 300)
myggsave(p_m_nicer_tadpole, width = 4, height = 5, use_mathpazo = TRUE)
save(p_m_tadpole, file = here::here("data_files/p_m_tadpole.RData"))
save(p_m_nicer_tadpole, file = here::here("data_files/p_m_nicer_tadpole.RData"))
```

```{r, eval = TRUE, fig.align='center', out.width="400px", out.height="500px", fig.cap = captioner("Comparison between theoretical and observed convergence behavior for the $L_2(\\Gamma\\times(0,T))$-error with respect to $m$ on a semi-$\\text{log}_{e}$ scale, with $m$ plotted on a square-root scale. Dashed lines indicate the theoretical rates, and solid lines represent the observed error curves. The legend below each plot shows the value of $\\alpha$ along with the corresponding benchmark ('bound'), and observed ('obs') rates for each case.")}
knitr::include_graphics(here::here("data_files/tikzpic/p_m_nicer_tadpole_with_mathpazo.pdf"))
```

The helper derivation and its restrictions are in `fun/tadpole_convergence.Rmd`.
Run `/usr/bin/Rscript --vanilla tests/check_convergence.R` to compare these
errors against the preserved research results and check auxiliary accuracy.
